_comment: The Hammunition Hill palette. The two brand colours are sampled from the
logo artwork itself, not chosen beside it: #912795 and #ed9a1c are the two
most common chromatic values in docs/images/logo.png, at 2.6% and 1.8% of
its opaque pixels. brand-deep is the shadow tone the artwork already uses
The surface and status ramps are the dashboard's, reproduced here so that
anything made off this package matches what the product actually looks
like. web/style.css is the source of truth for those; tests keep the two
